evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: Repository Charlie85270/Dorothy: 357 stars, MIT, homepage dorothyai.app, not archived.

evidence.title: Dorothy README
evidence.locator: Core Features; Automations; Kanban; Scheduled Tasks; Remote Control; Vault; MCP Servers; Installation; Architecture
evidence.finding: Desktop app to orchestrate Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok and local agents in parallel PTY terminals with a Super Agent orchestrator, Kanban, GitHub/JIRA automations, cron tasks, Telegram and Slack remote control, vault and usage tracking; macOS download; MIT.

evidence.title: Repository agent instructions
evidence.finding: Dorothy exposes Claude Code native memory; agents delegated by Dorothy are told to act autonomously.

evidence.title: MIT License
evidence.finding: MIT license, Copyright 2025 Claude Manager Contributors.

evidence.title: Dorothy website
evidence.finding: Free forever, open source, no account; Download for Mac; lists Claude, Codex, Gemini and Ollama; no pricing page.

evidence.title: Release 1.2.10
evidence.finding: Release 1.2.10 (2026-10-23) ships Dorothy-1.2.10-arm64.dmg and arm64 mac zip with latest-mac.yml; no Windows or Linux asset.

evidence.title: Package manifest
evidence.locator: version 1.2.10; build.mac target dmg and zip; dependencies
evidence.finding: electron-builder configured with macOS dmg and zip targets only (no win or linux block); no analytics dependencies in the app.

evidence.title: Agent manager
evidence.finding: Spawns one PTY per agent, uses worktreePath or projectPath as cwd and re-initialises a PTY for restored agents.

evidence.title: IPC handlers
evidence.finding: Creates git worktrees in a .worktrees folder inside the project, one per branch, with git worktree add when enabled; branch names validated.

evidence.title: Provider registry
evidence.locator: directory listing: claude, codex, gemini, grok, opencode, pi providers
evidence.finding: Provider modules for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok, OpenCode and pi that launch each CLI with its flags.

evidence.title: Claude provider
evidence.finding: Launches claude with --permission-mode default/auto or --dangerously-skip-permissions and writes hooks into Claude settings.

evidence.title: Local API server
evidence.finding: HTTP API listens on 127.0.0.1 with a random 32-byte token stored with mode 0600.

evidence.title: PermissionRequest hook
evidence.finding: Hook posts status waiting with reason permission to the local API; it does not approve or deny.

evidence.title: Telegram bot
evidence.finding: Telegram bot restricted to authorized chat IDs registered with /start; supports status, agents, projects, start/stop and ask commands.

evidence.title: Kanban automation
evidence.finding: Service that matches backlog tasks to agents by skills and moves them through columns.

evidence.title: Usage page
evidence.finding: Usage page computes cost from token counts and per-model prices read from Claude Code data.

evidence.title: Update checker
evidence.finding: electron-updater checks GitHub releases; download only after the user clicks.

evidence.title: Landing page layout
evidence.finding: The marketing landing page, not the app, includes @vercel/analytics.

evidence.title: Tasmania client
evidence.finding: Client for a local Tasmania control API on localhost:3999 used for local models.

evidence.title: Dashboard screenshot
evidence.finding: Real Dorothy Dashboard with six Claude Code terminals, statuses running and waiting.

evidence.title: Dorothy 1.2.10 source
evidence.locator: landing layout; electron/services/claude-service.ts lines 70-83; repo-wide search
evidence.finding: Vercel Analytics is imported only by the landing site; the Electron app has no analytics client, and its statsig references manage Claude CLI files.
